aboutSite.title: About This Site
description: This site was created as a portfolio website designed to complement a traditional resume.

At rest, the site stays readable as a conventional resume. Its goal is to preserve the clarity and familiarity of a standard resume while giving visitors a more engaging way to explore my projects and professional impact.

Additionally, this site serves as a central hub for all of my career data, allowing me to use AI agents to analyze my job search, identify trends, and generate actionable insights that can improve my chances of landing the right role.
